text: Toronto Public Health and the Wellesley Institute will share findings on the Thrive Toronto Mental Health Report Card and Toronto Public Health’s work to support mental health and well-being among 2SLGBTQ+ communities.

The Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee: 1. Requested the Manager, Gender Equity, Social Development to request the Medical Officer of Health to provide an update on Thrive Toronto Mental Health Report Card and Toronto Public Health Action on 2SLGBTQ+ Mental Health in the new term of Council.
